verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's docs describe how it remembers things across sessions: it writes plain Markdown memory files to the agent's workspace (default ~/.openclaw/workspace), so memory lasts beyond a single session. Each agent also keeps SQLite-backed session history. The docs note that the model only remembers what gets saved to disk, and the evidence does not show how writing and recall are triggered automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic memory writing and retrieval or search at recall time, and independent or hands-on confirmation that cross-session memory works for everyday users.
